falsifiable_hypothesis: The A branch is an auxiliary correction and should keep target-specific variance-level evidence. The B branch is the primary calibrated correction and its delete-one-inner-fold bias is a calibration quantity shared across equally weighted targets. In development diagnostics, the method-of-moments excess between-target variance of this bias collapsed to zero in every outer-training partition, motivating a common-mode B extra-bias estimator rather than another targetwise confidence exponent.
gain_rule: Reproduce shared_prior_margin_dual_gain gains exactly. No A or B gain fitting rule, bound, or gate changes.
theta_rule: For each outer-training partition compute theta_full, the K=3 delete-one-inner-fold theta_-k values, theta_loo=mean_k(theta_-k), bias_j=theta_full,j-theta_loo,j, jackknife variance v_j=(K-1)/K*sum_k(theta_-k,j-theta_loo,j)^2, and r_j=bias_j^2/(bias_j^2+v_j). Orientation A deploys thetaA_j=theta_full,j+(1+r_j)*bias_j, identical to the variance-level A rule in orientation_ordered_jackknife_theta. For orientation B compute the equal-target common bias mu_b=(1/24)*sum_j bias_j and deploy thetaB_j=theta_full,j+bias_j+mu_b. This is the verified half-jackknife base plus one common-mode extra correction. The unweighted mean is fixed because the primary metric weights all 24 targets equally.
common_mode_rationale: No outer-held fold or target outcome enters mu_b. No target routing, scale menu, exponent menu, or rescue rule is used. The same common scalar is estimated from fitting-only inner data and applied to all B targets within that outer partition. This family remains adaptive development because preceding outer outcomes were inspected.

task_contract.ab_rule: average losses across separately costed A/B orientations; never average predictions
